data.name: RegisterHeading
data.comment: The registration page's heading. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: RegisterIntro
data.value: You get a Space of your own straight away. There is nothing else to decide.
data.comment: Sits under the heading. States what registering gets you, because the whole point of this flow is that no structural decision is asked for. "Space" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: DisplayNameLabel
data.comment: Label for the display-name field. Deliberately not "full name" or "real name" - it is whatever this person wants to be called, and it is what their Space is named after.

data.name: DisplayNameHint
data.value: Your Space will be named after this.
data.comment: Help text under the name field, explaining a consequence that is otherwise a surprise.

data.name: EmailAddressLabel
data.comment: Label for the email field.

data.name: PasswordLabel
data.comment: Label for the password field.

data.name: SubmitLabel
data.comment: The submit button. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SubmitInFlight
data.value: Creating your Account. This takes a few seconds.
data.comment: Shown while the request is in flight, and announced politely. The wait is deliberately long - the password hashing is meant to be slow - so the copy says so plainly rather than leaving a person wondering whether anything happened. Never replace this with a spinner or a progress percentage.

data.name: SubmitComplete
data.value: Your Account is ready, and so is your Space.
data.comment: Announced when registration completes. Deliberately plain - no celebration. Note this is shown whether the address was new or already registered; the two are indistinguishable by design, so this copy must never imply that something was created just now for the first time.

data.name: SubmitFailed
data.value: That could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
data.comment: Shown when the request never reached the server, or the server answered with something unexpected. It is about the transport, not about the submission.

data.name: SubmitRetry
data.value: That did not go through. Please try again.
data.comment: Shown when the server refused the request's anti-forgery token - which happens for ordinary reasons a person cannot see or act on, such as another tab signing in, or a Session expiring while this form sat open. Pressing the button again fetches a fresh token and works, so this copy asks for exactly that and explains nothing: anti-forgery is not a concept the person has, and naming it would be alarming rather than useful. It must not imply they typed something wrong, and must not imply anything was saved.

data.name: ErrorHeading
data.value: Check the form and try again.
data.comment: Heading of the error region, announced assertively when validation fails. Followed by one line per problem.

data.name: SignInHeading
data.comment: The sign-in page's heading. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SignInIntro
data.value: One sign-in covers every Space you belong to.
data.comment: Sits under the heading. States the promise the story is about - moving between contexts never asks who you are again. "Space" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SignInSubmitLabel
data.comment: The submit button on the sign-in form.

data.name: SignInInFlight
data.value: Signing you in. This takes a few seconds.
data.comment: Shown while the request is in flight, and announced politely. The wait is deliberately long - checking the password is meant to be slow, and it takes the same time whether or not the address is known - so the copy says so plainly. Never replace this with a spinner or a progress percentage.

data.name: SignInComplete
data.comment: Announced when sign-in completes. Deliberately plain, and it names no Space: no Space is established by signing in, and there is nowhere to go yet.

data.name: SignInFailed
data.comment: THE ONLY MESSAGE FOR A FAILED SIGN-IN, AND IT COVERS EVERY CAUSE. Printed verbatim in the experience spine. It must never become "no account found", "wrong password" or anything else that says which of the two happened - the server answers one problem type with no detail, so this string is the whole of what a person is told, by design. Do not add a second string beside it, and do not add a "create an Account instead?" nudge here.

data.name: SignInToRegisterLink
data.comment: Link to the registration surface, below the sign-in form. It exists because registration would otherwise be reachable only by typing a path. It is NOT a response to a failed sign-in and must never be shown as one - that would say the address is unknown. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SessionEnded
data.value: Your Session ended. Sign in to continue.
data.comment: Shown when a person is returned here because their Session expired or stopped being valid. It names the Session and NOTHING else - no Space name, no Membership information, and never "you were removed": this is the cold path, where the person is not in a Space and must not be told anything about one. "Session" is Glossary vocabulary and is capitalised in every language, per rule 2 at the top of this file.

data.name: NotAvailable
data.comment: The heading of the refusal page for every not-found, whatever the cause - a Space with no Membership, a Space that does not exist, or an address that matches nothing (UX-DR32, EXPERIENCE.md:131-133). Identical for every cause by design: nothing on the page may distinguish them.

data.name: RefusalRouteBack
data.comment: The one link on the refusal page. It goes to the product's entry point, which lands on the first Space the switcher currently lists - never on a remembered last Space, which may itself be unavailable (EXPERIENCE.md:142, UX-DR32).

data.name: RoleDoesNotPermit
data.value: Your Role in this Space does not permit this.
data.comment: A capability refusal (403) that arrived without a capability code the client knows. Still capability-shaped: it names no object.

data.name: RoleOwner
data.comment: The Role chip for an Owner. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RoleAdmin
data.comment: The Role chip for an Admin. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RoleMember
data.comment: The Role chip for a Member. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RoleViewer
data.comment: The Role chip for a Viewer. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RolePermitsOwner
data.value: can manage everything in this Space, including ownership
data.comment: What an Owner may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Derived (story 1.7, open question 3): only an Owner may offer ownership or delete the Space.

data.name: RolePermitsAdmin
data.comment: What an Admin may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Verbatim from the specification (epics.md:826, EXPERIENCE.md:83).

data.name: RolePermitsMember
data.value: can create and edit Projects and Tasks
data.comment: What a Member may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Derived (story 1.7, open question 3).

data.name: RolePermitsViewer
data.comment: What a Viewer may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Verbatim from the specification (epics.md:826, EXPERIENCE.md:83).

data.name: ContextBarAccessibleName
data.comment: The context bar's accessible name. {0} is the Space's name, {1} the Role (RoleOwner and its siblings), {2} what the Role permits (RolePermitsOwner and its siblings). Example: "Northwind Redesign — Admin, can manage Members and settings". Keep the order if your language allows it; the em dash may be your language's equivalent separator.

data.name: SpaceSwitchAnnouncement
data.comment: Announced politely after the person switches Space: the destination's name {0}, Role {1} and what it permits {2}. Never names the Space they left (UX-DR38).

data.name: ContextBarShellName
data.comment: The context bar's accessible name when no Space is active - on the refusal page and when the Account belongs to no Space. Names no Space.

data.name: SwitchSpaceLabel
data.comment: The label on the button that opens the Space switcher, after the active Space's name.

data.name: SpaceSwitcherListLabel
data.comment: The accessible name of the switcher's list. Each row in it is a Space's name and nothing else.

data.name: SignOutLabel
data.comment: The button in the context bar that ends the Session - on every device the Account is signed in on, which is how the server ends it.

data.name: AccountSettingsLink
data.comment: The context bar's link to Account settings, after the Space switcher and before Sign out (story 1.8, EXPERIENCE.md:55).

data.name: AccountSettingsHeading
data.comment: The heading of Account settings.

data.name: ApiTokensHeading
data.comment: The heading of the API Token section of Account settings.

data.name: ApiTokenShownOnce
data.value: A Token is shown once, when it is generated. Copy it then: you will not be able to see it again.
data.comment: Said before any Token is generated (story 1.8, AC4; EXPERIENCE.md:274). Must say the Token is shown once and cannot be retrieved. Names no Role.

data.name: ApiTokenNameLabel
data.comment: The label of the Token's name field.

data.name: ApiTokenSpaceLabel
data.comment: The label of the picker choosing the one Space a Token reaches. Its options are the Space switcher's, by name.

data.name: ApiTokenGenerate
data.comment: The button that issues a Token.

data.name: ApiTokenNameInvalid
data.value: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
data.comment: A Token name the Host refused (urn:yello:problem:invalid-api-token).

data.name: ApiTokenShownNow
data.value: This Token is shown once. Copy it now: you will not be able to see it again.
data.comment: Shown above the plaintext, the only time it is shown.

data.name: ApiTokenPlaintextLabel
data.comment: The label of the read-only field holding the plaintext.

data.name: ApiTokenCopy
data.comment: The primary action while the plaintext is shown: copies it to the clipboard.

data.name: ApiTokenCopied
data.comment: Announced once the plaintext is on the clipboard.

data.name: ApiTokenCopyFailed
data.value: Copying did not work. Select the Token and copy it.
data.comment: Announced when the browser refused the clipboard. Focus moves to the field so it can be selected.

data.name: ApiTokenDone
data.comment: Asks to stop showing the plaintext. Never dismisses it on its own: a confirmation follows.

data.name: ApiTokenDismissWarning
data.value: You will not be able to see this Token again.
data.comment: The confirmation before the plaintext is dismissed - the only copy (story 1.8, AC4).

data.name: ApiTokenDismiss
data.comment: Confirms dismissing the plaintext.

data.name: ApiTokenKeepShowing
data.comment: Declines dismissing the plaintext.

data.name: ApiTokenListEmpty
data.comment: The Token list when the Account holds none.

data.name: ApiTokenRevoke
data.comment: Revokes a Token: asks first, then confirms.

data.name: ApiTokenRevokeWarning
data.value: Scripts using this Token will stop working.
data.comment: The confirmation before a Token is revoked.

data.name: ApiTokenCancel
data.comment: Declines revoking a Token.

data.name: SpaceHomeHeading
data.comment: The heading of a Space's home. It does not name the Space - the context bar does. "Project" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: ProjectsLoading
data.comment: For assistive technology only, inside the busy region shown while a Space's Project list is on its way (UX-DR35 cold load). Nothing of any Project renders before the answer (UX-DR31).

data.name: ProjectsEmpty
data.comment: A Space with no Projects (AC1, EXPERIENCE.md:252). A valid state, not an error; it asks for nothing but a Project - never for Statuses or configuration.

data.name: ProjectCreate
data.comment: The one action a Space offers to create a Project, empty or not. Absent - not disabled - for a Role that cannot create one (UX-DR27).

data.name: ProjectNameLabel
data.comment: The label of the name field, when creating or renaming a Project.

data.name: ProjectCreateSubmit
data.comment: Submits a new Project's name. Not "Save" (UX-DR26).

data.name: ProjectCreating
data.comment: Shown in place of the create actions while a creation is on its way, so it cannot be sent twice.

data.name: ProjectsLoaded
data.comment: Announced politely when a Space's Project list has arrived and replaced its skeleton (UX-DR35 cold load). Names no Project and no Space.

data.name: ProjectCreated
data.comment: Announced politely once a Project exists. {0} is its name, as the person typed it.

data.name: ProjectRename
data.comment: Both the row's control that opens a rename and the control that commits it. Never "Save": there is no save button anywhere (UX-DR26).

data.name: ProjectRenamed
data.comment: Announced politely once a rename is accepted. {0} is the new name.

data.name: ProjectCancel
data.comment: Closes a create or rename field without sending anything. Esc does the same.

data.name: ProjectNameInvalid
data.value: A Project name is 1 to 100 characters.
data.comment: The invalid-project-name refusal, beside the name field. Never "that name is taken" - Project names need not be unique.

data.name: NoSpaceHeading
data.comment: Heading shown to an Account that belongs to no Space. A valid state, not an error (UX-DR35); nothing is created for the person.

data.name: NoSpaceBody
data.value: You do not belong to any Space yet.
data.comment: The sentence under NoSpaceHeading. Creating a Space arrives with story 3.1; until then there is nothing to offer here.

data.name: read-projects-and-tasks
data.value: Only members of this Space can read its Projects and Tasks.
data.comment: A capability refusal (403), keyed on the capability code the Host sends. Capability-shaped, never object-shaped (EXPERIENCE.md:104): it names what a Role cannot do, never the thing it was refused on. It names the Roles the matrix denies, so it is true for whoever sees it.
